name: Ali Aryaeifar
para-one: I'm Ali aryaei, an enthusiastic Frontend Developer with a solid 5 years of experience in crafting dynamic and intuitive user interfaces using Vue, React, Next.js and Nuxt.
para-two: I take immense pride in my ability to bring designs to life and create seamless web experiences that captivateusers. From building interactive components to optimizing performance, my passion for frontend development drives me to stay abreast of the latest technologies and best practices.
yt-style-player-desc: A YouTube style video player with a modern design and features like autoplay, loop, and shuffle.
para-three: Let's connect and collaborate on exciting projects that push the boundaries of web development.
resume-desc: Download my resume as a PDF — experience, skills, and selected projects.
Connect: If you enjoy my works, Lets connect to each other
minagooDesc: Minagoo is an online English learning platform to Improve your language skills and it can be used for any age, level, and nationality.
menuDesc: A restaurant cafe menu with a beautiful design and interesting features such as table reservation, choosing food from the menu
137Desc: A system for municipalities with the possibility of  registering citizens reports in the city and following up on reports and solving urban problems by managers
karkiaDesc: The Karkia Mattress website is designed to streamline the  mattress shopping experience by offering a robust platform    for browsing, learning about, and purchasing high-quality mattresses. It combines detailed product information,  customer support, and e-commerce functionality to meet theneeds of modern consumers.
abdevaliDesc: The Abdevali Jewelry website serves a dual purpose as both a professional portfolio and an e-commerce platform. The  shop features product listings with descriptions, prices,  and images. Allows users to add products to a shopping  cart and proceed through a secure checkout process to  complete their purchases.
khadamatiDesc: A super service application to do all the different things in one app and quickly.
polygon-drawer-desc: A Vue 3 component for drawing, editing polygons on an image
video-desc: A minimal video player that supports .srt  and visual cue markers
english-digit-desc: A Vue 3 directive that automatically converts Persian to english
b2bdesc: Provides an online solution for booking, managing, and scheduling meetings. Users can view available time slots and reserve their desired meetings. The project focuses on a smooth user experience, clean architecture, and high performance.
learningNextDesc: An online health-sciences education platform for courses, events, and congresses. Built with Next.js for a modern experience for learners, experts, and organizers.
majaraDesc: A coworking and cafe platform for booking workspaces, meeting rooms, and community spaces across Tehran branches — from Iranshahr to Mirdamad. Built with Vue 2 and Nuxt 2.
doomDesc: A browser first-person shooter inspired by classic Doom — also made with AI, Next.js, and React.
doomDialogDesc: A browser FPS built with Next.js, React, and React Three Fiber. Pointer-lock mouse look, WASD movement, shooting, reloading, health, and pixel-sprite enemies in a 3D arena. Also made with AI as a fast experiment in bringing retro Doom-style gameplay to the web.
